name: cozi-mcp
description: Manage your Cozi lists, calendar, and family members from your AI assistant.
long_description: Unofficial MCP server for the Cozi Family Organizer. Lets your AI assistant read and update your shared shopping lists, to-do lists, and family calendar. Your Cozi credentials are stored in your OS keychain by Claude Desktop and never leave your machine — the author of this extension never sees your data.

password.title: Cozi password
password.description: Your Cozi account password. Stored securely in your OS keychain.

tools.name: get_lists
tools.description: Summarize all lists. Optionally filter by 'shopping' or 'todo'.

tools.name: get_list_items
tools.description: Items in one list. Excludes completed by default.

tools.name: add_item
tools.description: Add an item to a list.

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: Update an item's text and/or completion status.

tools.name: update_appointment
tools.description: Partial-update an appointment, preserving fields you don't pass.
